department: Department of Mechanical Engineering (Howard R. Hughes College of Engineering)

deadline.value: International applicants must apply by May 1 for fall; the department's own date is August 1.
deadline.quote: All application materials must be submitted to the Graduate College through the Application Portal by May 1 (fall semester)

gre_general.value: The department requires GRE scores at or above the 75th percentile in quantitative reasoning; a provisional admission with a retake is possible.
gre_general.quote: the applicant must be at or above the 75 percentile range

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The department document does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department document does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: Either a post-master's track or a post-bachelor's track for strong undergraduates.
entry_route.quote: Application for the Ph.D. program can be completed by one of two mechanisms.

also.quote: allows those undergraduates with outstanding undergraduate backgrounds to enter the Ph.D. program without having to complete an M.S. degree

notes: Department document (2024): post-bachelor's needs a 3.50 GPA and post-master's needs a 3.30 GPA for US-accredited graduates. The Dec 2024 table lists no GRE for this PhD, but the department document requires it, so the department rule is saved.
